title: Lena and the Orchard
author: Ada Fairweather
blurb: Odile Ishikawa, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the century turns.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
